cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Hello, Oyster Bay Sailing Club. How can I help you?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh hi. I'd like to find out about sailing courses for beginners.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: No problem. Is it for yourself?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes. I had a look online but I'm not sure which course would be best.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: OK. Well you might be interested in our Taster Days?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Possibly.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: So these are for people who've never sailed before – it's basically an introduction to sailing to find out whether you enjoy it and want to carry on with it.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And how much is that?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: It's £120 for the day - but it's reduced to £110 each if there are two of you.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: No, it would just be me.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Oh that's fine. You'd be in a small group, usually about eight people but no more than ten – and everyone's always very friendly. (Q1)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Uh huh. And are there any other suitable courses?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: The other option is the Level 1 course. These are two-day weekend courses and we run those all year round.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. And what do you learn on that course?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: This is a mix of theory and practical skills. So you learn about things like the weather (Q2), which is obviously really important and also the tides, as well as learning basic sailing skills. You go out into the harbour in special training dinghies for beginners, two people in each dinghy and an instructor. He or she will make sure you understand everything you need to know about safety. (Q3)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: It sounds like hard work!

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, but you'll have a lot of fun too.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And the cost of that one is... ?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: £200. But it's a bit cheaper if you decide to join the club. There's a discount for members. (Q4)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, I'm not sure about that yet.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: You've got plenty of time to decide.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And does the cost include everything?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, everything's included and you also get a really good dictionary explaining all the sailing terminology (Q5). A lot of people struggle with this at first. It's got lots of pictures, so I'm sure you'd find it really helpful. And on completion of the course you get a certificate (Q6). Then you're ready to move on to the Level 2 course.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sounds good.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I think that's all the info you need for now. Just a couple of general things. For example, it's really important that you know how to swim.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes, I'm pretty confident in the water.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Great. The other thing I should tell you is that we provide wetsuits and life jackets but you need to bring swimming trunks and some old trainers.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And a towel? (Q7)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes definitely. And you might want to bring your own toiletries, things like shampoo.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. What about food and drink? Do I need to bring that or is there a café at the club? (Q8)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, you can get sandwiches, cakes and snacks there. The food's pretty reasonable.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK good. Well I think I'm interested in the Level 1 course. But I know absolutely nothing about sailing so is there anything I can do to prepare myself a bit?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I recommend you watch some videos we use for training. They're available online. I can send you the link. They'll give you an idea of what to expect. (Q9)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Perfect, thanks. That would be very helpful. Oh and just one other thing - I'll be cycling to the club and will need somewhere to put valuables. I'm just wondering if there are lockers for people to use? (Q10)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, there are plenty in the changing rooms.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Great. OK well could you book me onto...
